faq_intro: Questions Bangladesh distributors and fleet operators ask about our three-wheeler engine parts.
faqs: Which models do your engine parts fit?
They suit a large variety of three-wheeler models. Share your models or part numbers and our support team will confirm the right part.
Do the parts improve fuel efficiency?
They are designed to support engine performance and fuel efficiency when fitted correctly.
How do you check engine parts?
Dimensions and surface finish are verified before packing, so parts fit without extra machining.
Can you produce engine parts from our drawings?
Yes. Our casting and CNC machining lines can make parts from customer drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Can I mix engine parts with clutch parts?
Yes. We ship engine, clutch and brake parts together in one consignment, labelled by model.
How are engine parts shipped to Bangladesh?
In corrosion-protected export packing by sea, as FCL or LCL, with complete documents for customs clearance.
Do you supply parts for older auto rickshaws?
Where a model is still common on the road, we can often supply matching engine parts. Send the model and part number to check.
